text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as I was wondering why Ines Fuujin 
hadn't shown up for training—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry... It got so late on me.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Actually, my bike got a flat tire, and 
fixing it made me this late...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I always seem to pop my front tire. Maybe 
I'm leaning too far forward.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though her tardiness was beyond her 
control, I made sure Ines Fujin understood 
the need to reflect on it.
